purpose: Black-box durable execution, worker recovery, outbox, idempotency, replay, and human-wait contract.
invariants: execution stores the exact immutable published workflow version hash
workspace scope is present on every runtime row and enforced through PostgreSQL RLS
the same workspace idempotency key returns the same execution without duplicate steps
worker claims use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and stale claims are recoverable
external writes have durable workspace-scoped idempotency receipts
outbox events are transactionally recorded and dedupe-keyed
human wait and resume are explicit state transitions
replay is dry-run, tools are stubbed, and external write receipts do not increase
correlation, model, prompt, token, latency, cost, retry, and audit evidence is inspectable
